# Tier `blackwell-16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 32768 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-26b-a4b` | the model that stays hot and is the agent's default |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 32768 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `gpu` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #1 (5060 Ti 16GB, Blackwell sm_120). 26B resident full-GPU (-ngl 99). REQUIRES the Blackwell CUDA-12.8 sm_120 build (Task H4) - the pinned 12.4 asset lacks sm_120 and the 13.x asset segfaults the MMQ kernel into a ~5.6x-slower cuBLAS fallback. H3 may push ctx to 64K with q8. config_seed: quality-first media bindings PROVEN on this exact tier (bf16 O1 = 3.9min/2048 render via RAM offload; needs the model downloads + >=~48GB system RAM — see SETUP-AGENT). PROJECTED.
